name: git-collaboration-hygiene
description: Always-on Git collaboration posture for AI coding agents: inspect status, protect user changes, stage explicit paths, review diffs, and avoid unsafe pushes or conflict handling.

source.title: AI OS Git Collaboration Hygiene
source.relationship: Authored as a portable baseline pack from repeated AI OS collaboration and multi-agent git hygiene requirements. Principles 40-44 added 2026-09-01, and principle 35 extended with an ask-before-pushing-to-a-reviewed-PR nuance, via the baseline-gap-review skill's occurrence #2 pass over _Improvements.
